newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends sharply lower on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends sharply lower on USDA data.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed sharply lower and set new contract lows on widespread selling tied to USDA's September crop report, traders said.
"There was widespread hedging and speculative selling all session," a trader said. "And we didn't have the mill buying like we've had recently ahead of the report."
USDA raised 1996-97 wheat ending stocks to 506 million bushels from the August forecast for 409 million bushels.
MGE spring wheat closed two to 14 cents per bushel lower, with Sept down 13 cents at $4.43. Dec lost 14 cents to end at $4.20 -- just above Wednesday's new contract low of $4.19.
Traders said Wilson bought and sold one million Dec bushels. Benson Quinn and LFG each sold at least 1.5 million Dec bushels. CIS bought 1.2 million Dec bushels, traders said.
MGE barley closed steady to five cents per hundredweight lower, with Sept unchanged at $7.40 per cwt. Dec lost two cents to close at $7.47 per cwt.
